content: The Habana Leon brand was established by José Pepin Garcia and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The brand pays homage to one of Cuba's legendary baseball teams, the Club Habana team, which played under the name Habana Leones (Havana Lions). This team was affectionately referred to as los Rojos (The Reds) due to their team color. The brand celebrates the legacy of this iconic Cuban baseball team, and the red color theme is reflected in the cigar band, which features a red background with gold lettering. The brand offers a single line consisting of seven different vitolas. This cigar is characterized as full-bodied. The filler is composed of 70% Nicaraguan ligero tobacco. It features a Nicaraguan wrapper and an additional Nicaraguan-grown Corojo wrapper, which originates from the 2000 crop.
